meta.small_rule: Piyasa değeri 80 milyon Avustralya dolarının (yaklaşık 54 milyon ABD doları) altındaki şirketler dışarıda kalır.
meta.inflation_note: Avustralya şirketleri enflasyon muhasebesi uygulamaz. Bu yüzden bütün şirketlerin özsermaye kârlılığı yıl sonu tüketici enflasyonuyla düzeltildi: 2021 için %3,5, 2022 için %7,8, 2023 için %4,1, 2024 için %2,4, 2025 için %3,8. Son 12 ay için en son açıklanan yıllık oran (Eylül 2026, %4,3) kullanıldı.
data_notes: Fiyat, piyasa değeri, F/K ve PD/DD: TradingView tarayıcısı, 13 Kasım 2026 kapanışı; veri 15 Kasım'da toplandı. Evren ASX'teki 1.563 paydır. Borsa yatırım fonları evrende yoktur; evrendeki gayrimenkul yatırım ortaklıkları ve yatırım şirketleri (yaklaşık 60) 1. surda dışarıda kalır.

Karşılaştırma: ASX, Ekim 2026 için 1.893 kote şirket açıklıyor (yerli ve yabancı pay ihraççıları; birleşik pay gruplarının her kuruluşu ayrı sayılır). Evren bu sayının %17,4 altında. Olası nedenler: ana kotasyonu başka ülkede olan paylar evrende yok (Rio Tinto Ltd, ResMed, Newmont, James Hardie, Fisher & Paykel, Amcor, News Corp); büyük yatırım şirketlerinin bir bölümü yok (AFIC, Argo, WAM Capital, BKI); ASX birleşik grupların her kuruluşunu ayrı sayıyor; işlemi durdurulmuş şirketler evrende yok. Rio Tinto Ltd'nin evrende olmaması, değerlendirildiği anlamına gelmez.

Denetim (16 Kasım 2026): BHP, CBA, Westpac, NAB ve ANZ ikinci kaynakla karşılaştırıldı. ANZ'de fiyat, piyasa değeri ve F/K 13 Kasım tarihli sayfayla aynı; PD/DD 1,67'ye karşı 1,68. Öbür dördünde ikinci kaynağın sayfaları iki üç hafta eskiydi; fiyata ölçeklenince F/K ve PD/DD %3 içinde tuttu (BHP'nin PD/DD'si denetlenemedi). Westpac'in F/K'sı bankanın 2 Kasım'da açıkladığı 6,8 milyar dolarlık kârla 19,0; evrende 19,03. BHP'nin piyasa değeri şirketin tamamıdır (5.084 milyon pay).

Şirketin belgesiyle düzeltilenler (16 Kasım 2026). Kaynağın PD/DD alanı boş olan 33 şirkette PD/DD aynı kaynağın bilanço alanlarından tamamlandı; denetlenen iki şirkette sonuç şirketin bilançosuyla tutmadı: FDC Consolidated ve Accent Resources'ta kaynak artı PD/DD verirken 30 Haziran 2026 bilançolarında özsermaye eksi. İkisi de belgeden düzeltildi. Bu 33 şirketin hepsi zararda ya da kâr verisi yok; hiçbiri 1. suru geçmez, ama sayfalarındaki PD/DD'ye temkinli bakılmalı.

MAAS Group'un F/K'sı toplayıcının hesabında 18,64 idi; şirketin 2026 mali yılı belgesine göre 10,34 (hisse başına kâr 37,7 sent) ve belgeden düzeltildi. Kârın yaklaşık %45'i satılmakta olan yapı malzemeleri işinden. Pure One'ın F/K'sı (1,62) ikinci kaynaklarla 1,9-2,2 çıkıyor; şirketin belgesi açılamadığı için düzeltilmedi. Pure One'ın piyasa değeri 12,8 milyon dolar; 1. surda zaten dışarıda kalır.
Veri kaynağı 29 şirkette son 12 ayın kârını vermiyor; çoğu yeni listelenmiş arama şirketi ya da fon (en büyükleri L1 Gold Fund ve Brazilian Rare Earths). Aralarında bilinen büyük bir işletme yok.

BHP, Rio Tinto ve birçok maden ve enerji şirketi tablolarını ABD dolarıyla açıklar; payları Avustralya dolarıyla işlem görür. Oranlar para biriminden bağımsızdır; enflasyon düzeltmesi Avustralya enflasyonuyla yapıldı. Çoğu şirketin mali yılı 30 Haziran'da biter ve bilanço yılda iki kez açıklanır; bankaların mali yılı 30 Eylül'de biter.

Beş yıllık oranlar: stockanalysis.com oran sayfaları; 120 adayın hepsinin sayfası geldi. Yıl sonu enflasyonu: Avustralya İstatistik Bürosu (ABS), tüketici fiyat endeksi, aralık çeyreğinin yıllık değişimi (2021-2024) ve Aralık 2025'e kadarki 12 ay (2025; ABS o tarihten beri aylık endeksi açıklıyor). Son yıllık oran: ABS, Eylül 2026 (%4,3).

2. suru geçen 36 şirketin 10'u okundu (16 Kasım 2026): 7'si 3. suru geçti (Wesfarmers, Aristocrat, Brambles, REA Group, Pro Medicus, Medibank, The Lottery Corporation), 3'ü geçemedi (BHP ve West African Resources: emtia; Reef Casino Trust). Kale yok: 3. suru geçenlerin hepsinde fiyat temkinli değerin çok üstünde. 26 şirket sırada bekliyor. Reef Casino Trust'ta kaynağın oranları yanıltıcı: tröst payların yarısını borç sayıyor; ayrıca pay alım teklifi altında. Pro Medicus'un son 12 ay kârının yaklaşık %46'sı bir yatırımın değer artışıydı ve kazanç yargısında düşüldü.

en.inflation_note: Australian companies do not apply inflation accounting. The return on equity of every company was therefore adjusted by year-end consumer inflation: 3.5% for 2021, 7.8% for 2022, 4.1% for 2023, 2.4% for 2024 and 3.8% for 2025. For the last 12 months the most recently published annual rate (September 2026, 4.3%) was used.
data_notes: Price, market value, P/E and P/B: TradingView screener, close of 13 November 2026; data collected on 15 November. The universe is 1,563 stocks on ASX. Exchange-traded funds are not in the universe; the real estate investment trusts and investment companies in it (about 60) stay outside at Wall 1.

For comparison: ASX reports 1,893 listed companies for October 2026 (domestic and foreign equity issuers; every entity of a stapled group is counted separately). The universe is 17.4% below that number. Likely reasons: stocks whose main listing is in another country are not in the universe (Rio Tinto Ltd, ResMed, Newmont, James Hardie, Fisher & Paykel, Amcor, News Corp); some large investment companies are missing (AFIC, Argo, WAM Capital, BKI); ASX counts every entity of a stapled group; suspended companies are not in the universe. Rio Tinto Ltd not being in the universe does not mean it was assessed.

Checks (16 November 2026): BHP, CBA, Westpac, NAB and ANZ were compared with a second source. For ANZ, price, market value and P/E equal the page dated 13 November; P/B is 1.67 against 1.68. For the other four the second source's pages were two to three weeks old; scaled to the price, P/E and P/B agreed within 3% (BHP's P/B could not be checked). Westpac's P/E is 19.0 on the 6.8 billion dollar profit the bank reported on 2 November; 19.03 in the universe. BHP's market value is the whole company (5,084 million shares).

Corrected with the companies' own documents (16 November 2026). For 33 companies where the source's P/B field is empty, P/B was completed from the same source's balance-sheet fields; for the two companies checked, the result did not agree with the company's balance sheet: for FDC Consolidated and Accent Resources the source gave a positive P/B while equity is negative in their balance sheets of 30 June 2026. Both were corrected from the document. All 33 of these companies are loss-making or have no profit data; none passes Wall 1, but the P/B on their pages should be read with caution.

MAAS Group's P/E was 18.64 in the collector's calculation; according to the company's FY2026 document it is 10.34 (earnings per share 37.7 cents), and it was corrected from the document. About 45% of the profit comes from the construction materials business that is being sold. Pure One's P/E (1.62) comes out at 1.9-2.2 with second sources; it was not corrected because the company's document could not be opened. Pure One's market value is 12.8 million dollars; it stays outside at Wall 1 anyway.

For 29 companies the data source gives no profit figure for the last 12 months; most are newly listed explorers or funds (the largest are L1 Gold Fund and Brazilian Rare Earths). There is no well-known large business among them.

BHP, Rio Tinto and many mining and energy companies report in US dollars while their shares trade in Australian dollars. Ratios do not depend on the currency; the inflation adjustment uses Australian inflation. Most companies' financial year ends on 30 June and they publish a balance sheet twice a year; the banks' financial year ends on 30 September.

Five-year ratios: stockanalysis.com ratio pages; the pages of all 120 candidates arrived. Year-end inflation: Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS), consumer price index, annual change of the December quarter (2021-2024) and the 12 months to December 2025 (2025; ABS has published the monthly index as its headline since then). Latest annual rate: ABS, September 2026 (4.3%).

10 of the 36 companies that passed Wall 2 have been read (16 November 2026): 7 passed Wall 3 (Wesfarmers, Aristocrat, Brambles, REA Group, Pro Medicus, Medibank, The Lottery Corporation) and 3 did not (BHP and West African Resources: commodity; Reef Casino Trust). There is no castle: for every company that passed Wall 3 the price is far above the conservative value. 26 companies are waiting in the queue. For Reef Casino Trust the source's ratios are misleading: the trust books half of its units as debt; it is also under a takeover offer. About 46% of Pro Medicus's profit for the last 12 months was a fair value gain on an investment and was deducted in the earnings judgment.

WAF.one: Burkina Faso'da iki madenden altın çıkarır. Kalite surlarını geçti; kârı altın fiyatı ve tek bir devletin kararları belirlediği için hendek surunda elendi.
WAF.business: West African Resources, Burkina Faso'daki Sanbrado ve Kiaka madenlerinden altın çıkarır ve satar. Geliri satılan ons ile altın fiyatının çarpımıdır. 2026'nın ilk yarısında 232.905 ons üretti (Sanbrado 99.631, Kiaka 133.274), 214.883 ons sattı; ortalama satış fiyatı ons başına 6.758 Avustralya doları (4.744 ABD doları), hasılat 1.462,7 milyon Avustralya doları oldu. Toplam sürdürme maliyeti ons başına 1.823 ABD doları. Kiaka 2025'te devreye girdi; şirket Avustralya doları ile raporlar.
WAF.moat_text: Hendek yok. Altın bir emtiadır; şirket fiyatı kendisi belirleyemez. İlk yarıda hasılat 477,3 milyon dolardan 1.462,7 milyon dolara çıktı; bunu yeni Kiaka madeni ve altın fiyatı birlikte sağladı. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı fiyatı izliyor: 2023'te %15,3, 2025'te %31,9, son 12 ayda %39,7. Maliyet üstünlüğü de kalıcı değil: toplam sürdürme maliyeti 2025'te ons başına 1.488 ABD dolarıydı, 2026'nın ilk yarısında 1.823 ABD doları. Fiyat yükseldikçe devletin payı da büyüyor: devlet hakkı ilk yarıda 181,5 milyon dolar (hasılatın %12,4'ü; bir yıl önce 37,8 milyon dolar); oran altın 3.000 ABD dolarını aştıkça her 500 dolarda bir puan artıyor. B puanı 0 olduğu için şirket bu surda elendi. Kaynak verisinde kusur aradık, bulamadık: F/K ve PD/DD şirketin kendi tablolarıyla tutuyor.
WAF.mgmt: Burkina Faso devleti üç işletme şirketinin her birinde %15 paya sahip (önce %10'du) ve dağıtılabilir kârın %15'ini öncelikli temettü olarak alır: ilk yarıda 2025 için 67,2 milyon dolar ödendi, 2026'nın ilk yarısı için 79,8 milyon dolar karşılık ayrıldı. 16 Nisan 2026 tarihli kararname devlet şirketi SOPAMIB'e Kiaka'nın %25'ini 70 milyar CFA frangına (yaklaşık 175 milyon Avustralya doları) alma yetkisi verdi; tamamlanınca şirketin Kiaka payı %85'ten %60'a iner. 28 Ekim 2026 tarihli habere göre anlaşma henüz tamamlanmadı. Şirket ilk temettüsünü 2026'da açıkladı: hisse başına 20 sent özel temettü (228,8 milyon dolar), ekimde ödendi. 2024'te Kiaka için 150 milyon dolarlık pay ihraç edildi (109,5 milyon pay); beş yılda pay sayısı %30,4 arttı. 30 Haziran 2026'da nakit 876,3 milyon dolar, borç 388,1 milyon dolar. Hisse bazlı ücret küçük: ilk yarıda 2,5 milyon dolar (kârın %1'inden az). Bilanço dışı yükümlülük: Kiaka'da kalan 1.298.000 ons için %3 net izabe hakkı ve 1,30 milyon ons için ons başına 12,44 ABD doları üretim ödemesi. Büyük ortaklara ve şerefiyeye bakıldı; okunan belgelerde yok.
WAF.latest: 10 Eylül 2026: Şirket 2026'nın ilk yarı raporunu yayımladı. Hasılat 1.462,7 milyon dolar (bir yıl önce 477,3), vergi sonrası kâr 436,6 milyon dolar (214,6); ana ortaklığa düşen kâr 351,4 milyon dolar (185,8), hisse başına kâr 30,7 sent (16,3). Ana ortaklığa ait özsermaye 1.958,5 milyon dolar. Kur farkı ilk yarıda 25,9 milyon dolar zarar yazdırdı (bir yıl önce 52,5 milyon dolar kazanç); 21,0 milyon dolarlık idari ceza karşılığı ayrıldı. 28 Ekim 2026 tarihli habere göre üçüncü çeyrekte 127.950 ons üretildi, nakit 1,2 milyar dolara çıktı; 2026 üretim beklentisi 430.000-490.000 ons.
risks: Kâr altın fiyatına bağlıdır; beş yıllık geçmiş tam bir döngüyü göstermez. Son 12 ayın kârı fiyatın çok yüksek olduğu bir dönemin kârıdır.

Bütün üretim tek ülkededir. Burkina Faso devleti payını önce %10'dan %15'e çıkardı, şimdi Kiaka'nın %25'ini daha alıyor; şirketin Kiaka kârındaki payı %85'ten %60'a inecek. İlk yarıda üretimin %57'si Kiaka'dan geldi.

en.one: Mines gold in Burkina Faso. It passed the quality walls but failed the moat wall: the gold price and one government set its profit.
en.business: West African Resources mines and sells gold from the Sanbrado and Kiaka mines in Burkina Faso. Its revenue is ounces sold times the gold price. In the first half of 2026 it produced 232,905 ounces (Sanbrado 99,631, Kiaka 133,274) and sold 214,883 ounces at an average price of 6,758 Australian dollars (4,744 US dollars) an ounce; revenue was 1,462.7 million Australian dollars. All-in sustaining cost was 1,823 US dollars an ounce. Kiaka started up in 2025; the company reports in Australian dollars.
en.moat_text: No moat. Gold is a commodity; the company cannot set its price. First-half revenue rose from 477.3 million dollars to 1,462.7 million; the new Kiaka mine and the gold price did this together. Real return on equity follows the price: 15.3% in 2023, 31.9% in 2025, 39.7% over the last 12 months. The cost advantage is not durable either: all-in sustaining cost was 1,488 US dollars an ounce in 2025 and 1,823 US dollars in the first half of 2026. As the price rises the state's take grows too: government royalties were 181.5 million dollars in the first half (12.4% of revenue; 37.8 million a year earlier); the rate rises by one point for every 500 dollars above 3,000 US dollars. With a B score of 0 the company fails this wall. We looked for a flaw in the source data and found none: P/E and P/B match the company's own statements.
en.mgmt: The state of Burkina Faso owns 15% of each of the three operating companies (10% before) and takes 15% of distributable profit as a priority dividend: 67.2 million dollars was paid in the first half for 2025, and 79.8 million was provided for the first half of 2026. A decree of 16 April 2026 authorised the state company SOPAMIB to buy 25% of Kiaka for 70 billion CFA francs (about 175 million Australian dollars); on completion the company's share of Kiaka falls from 85% to 60%. According to a report of 28 October 2026 the deal was not yet completed. The company declared its first dividend in 2026: a special dividend of 20 cents a share (228.8 million dollars), paid in October. In 2024 it issued shares worth 150 million dollars for Kiaka (109.5 million shares); the share count rose 30.4% in five years. At 30 June 2026 cash was 876.3 million dollars and borrowings 388.1 million. Share-based pay is small: 2.5 million dollars in the first half (under 1% of profit). Off-balance-sheet obligations: a 3% net smelter royalty on the remaining 1,298,000 ounces at Kiaka and a production payment of 12.44 US dollars an ounce on 1.30 million ounces. We looked for major shareholders and goodwill; not in the documents we read.
en.latest: 10 September 2026: The company published its 2026 half-year report. Revenue was 1,462.7 million dollars (477.3 a year earlier) and profit after tax 436.6 million (214.6); profit attributable to owners was 351.4 million (185.8) and earnings per share 30.7 cents (16.3). Equity attributable to owners was 1,958.5 million dollars. Foreign exchange produced a loss of 25.9 million dollars in the half (a gain of 52.5 million a year earlier); a provision of 21.0 million was made for regulatory fines. According to a report of 28 October 2026, third-quarter production was 127,950 ounces and cash rose to 1.2 billion dollars; production guidance for 2026 is 430,000-490,000 ounces.
risks: Profit depends on the gold price; five years of history do not show a full cycle. The last 12 months' profit was earned at a very high price.

All production is in one country. The state of Burkina Faso first raised its share from 10% to 15% and is now taking another 25% of Kiaka; the company's share of Kiaka's profit will fall from 85% to 60%. Kiaka gave 57% of first-half production.
The royalty rate rises with the gold price; part of any price increase goes to the state, not to the owner.
The company operates in Burkina Faso and its shares trade in Australia; the inflation adjustment uses Australian inflation.

verify.tr: Sırada kale adayı göründüğü için önce veri kusuru arandı; bulunmadı. Hisse başına kâr: 2025 yılı 41,6 sent + 2026 ilk yarı 30,7 sent − 2025 ilk yarı 16,3 sent = 56,0 sent; fiyat 3,45 ÷ 0,560 = 6,2 (evrendeki F/K 6,2). Ana ortaklığa ait özsermaye 30 Haziran 2026'da 1.958,5 milyon dolar; piyasa değeri 3.950,1 ÷ 1.958,5 = 2,02 (evrendeki PD/DD 2,01). Pay bölünmesi yok; son 12 ayda tek seferlik kazanç yok (Kiaka pay satışı tamamlanmadığı için kazanç yazılmadı). Dönemden sonra iki şey değişiyor: ekimde ödenen 228,8 milyon dolarlık özel temettü özsermayeyi azaltır; Kiaka'nın %25'i devredilince ana ortaklığa düşen kâr azalır. Düşük F/K'nın nedeni veri değil, altın fiyatının zirvesindeki kâr ve ülke riskidir.
verify.en: Because the queue showed it as a castle candidate we first looked for a data flaw; there is none. Earnings per share: 41.6 cents for 2025 + 30.7 cents for the first half of 2026 − 16.3 cents for the first half of 2025 = 56.0 cents; price 3.45 ÷ 0.560 = 6.2 (P/E in the universe 6.2). Equity attributable to owners was 1,958.5 million dollars at 30 June 2026; market value 3,950.1 ÷ 1,958.5 = 2.02 (P/B in the universe 2.01). No share split; no one-off gain in the last 12 months (no gain was booked because the Kiaka stake sale is not complete). Two things change after the period: the special dividend of 228.8 million dollars paid in October reduces equity; once 25% of Kiaka is transferred, profit attributable to owners falls. The low P/E comes not from the data but from profit at the top of the gold price and from country risk.

RCT.one: Cairns'teki otel ve kumarhane binasının sahibi olan fon. Yüksek özsermaye kârlılığı muhasebe sınıflamasından geliyor; hendek surunda elendi. Fon devralındı, borsadan çıkarılması isteniyor.
RCT.business: Reef Casino Trust, Avustralya'nın Cairns kentindeki Reef Hotel Casino binasının sahibidir. Binayı işletmeciye (Casinos Austria International (Cairns) Pty Ltd) kiralar; geliri kiradır. 2025'te kira 26,6 milyon dolardı: 1,4 milyon doları sabit kira, 25,2 milyon doları işletmecinin sonucuna bağlı kira. 2026'nın ilk yarısında kira 10,4 milyon dolar oldu (kumarhane 9,3 milyon, otel ve diğer 1,1 milyon). Fonun 49.801.036 payı var. Dağıtılabilir kârın tamamı pay sahiplerine dağıtılır.
RCT.moat_text: Hendek zayıf. Fonun tek varlığı tek bir bina, tek kiracısı tek bir işletmecidir; gelirinin çoğu işletmecinin sonucuna bağlıdır. Dağıtılabilir kâr büyümüyor: 2024'te 10,2 milyon dolar, 2025'te 10,8 milyon dolar, 2026'nın ilk yarısında 3,298 milyon dolar (bir yıl önce 3,300). Sayfadaki reel özsermaye kârlılığı (beş yıl ortalaması %47,0) gerçek bir üstünlüğü göstermez; muhasebe sınıflamasının sonucudur. Fon, payların yarısını borç sayar: 85,051 milyon dolar yükümlülük, 10,082 milyon dolar özsermaye. Dağıtılabilir kârın yarısı da "pay sahiplerine ait finansman gideri" yazılır. İkisi birlikte alınınca pay sahiplerinin toplam parası 95,1 milyon dolar, son 12 ayın dağıtılabilir kârı 10,8 milyon dolardır; getiri enflasyondan önce yaklaşık %11,4 (bizim hesabımız). Kumarhane lisansının süresine ve bölgedeki tekel hakkına bakıldı; okunan belgelerde yok. B puanı 1 olduğu için fon bu surda elendi.
RCT.mgmt: Sahiplik 2026'da değişti. Iris Cairns Property Trust ilk teklifiyle payların %85,77'sini aldı (42.712.230 pay); Accor ve Casinos Austria temsilcileri 14 Ağustos 2026'da yönetimden ayrıldı. Iris 24 Eylül 2026'da kalan paylar için pay başına 4,67 dolar nakit, koşulsuz ikinci bir teklif verdi; teklif süresi 8 Ekim - 9 Kasım 2026. Iris, hakkı doğarsa kalan payları zorunlu olarak alacağını ve fonu borsadan çıkaracağını açıkladı. Teklifin sonucuna bakıldı; okunan belgelerde yok. Fon kârının tamamını dağıtır; 2025 dağıtımı pay başına 21,73 sent. Devralma giderleri kârı azalttı: 2025'te 1,3 milyon dolar; ilk yarıda 0,2 milyon dolar; dönemden sonra danışmanlara 2,836 milyon dolar başarı ücreti ödendi. en.one: Owns the Cairns hotel and casino building. Its high return on equity is an accounting effect; it failed the moat wall. Now taken over.
en.business: Reef Casino Trust owns the Reef Hotel Casino complex in Cairns, Australia. It leases the complex to the operator (Casinos Austria International (Cairns) Pty Ltd); its income is rent. In 2025 rent was 26.6 million dollars: 1.4 million base rent and 25.2 million contingent on the operator's results. In the first half of 2026 rent was 10.4 million dollars (casino 9.3 million, hotel and other 1.1 million). The trust has 49,801,036 units. All distributable profit is paid out to unitholders.
en.moat_text: The moat is weak. The trust's only asset is one building and its only tenant is one operator; most of its income depends on the operator's results. Distributable profit is not growing: 10.2 million dollars in 2024, 10.8 million in 2025, 3.298 million in the first half of 2026 (3.300 a year earlier). The real return on equity on the page (five-year average 47.0%) does not show a real advantage; it is the result of an accounting classification. The trust treats half of its units as debt: a liability of 85.051 million dollars and equity of 10.082 million. Half of distributable profit is also booked as "finance costs attributable to unitholders". Taken together, unitholders' total funds are 95.1 million dollars and distributable profit over the last 12 months is 10.8 million; the return is about 11.4% before inflation (our calculation). We looked for the term of the casino licence and any regional exclusivity; not in the documents we read. With a B score of 1 the trust fails this wall.
en.mgmt: Ownership changed in 2026. Iris Cairns Property Trust acquired 85.77% of the units with its first bid (42,712,230 units); the Accor and Casinos Austria nominees left the board on 14 August 2026. On 24 September 2026 Iris made a second, unconditional cash offer of 4.67 dollars a unit for the remaining units; the offer period ran from 8 October to 9 November 2026. Iris said that, if entitled, it will compulsorily acquire the remaining units and remove the trust from the exchange. We looked for the outcome of the offer; not in the documents we read. The trust pays out all its profit; the 2025 distribution was 21.73 cents a unit. Takeover costs reduced profit: 1.3 million dollars in 2025; 0.2 million in the first half; after the period a success fee of 2.836 million dollars was paid to advisers. Debt is low: 5.5 million dollars drawn on a 15.0 million facility. We looked for share-based pay, goodwill and pension obligations; not in the documents we read.
en.latest: 28 August 2026: The trust published its half-year report. Revenue was 10.5 million dollars (11.2 a year earlier; down 6.7%), distributable profit 3.298 million (3.300) and profit attributable to unitholders 1.649 million (1.650). The distribution was 6.63 cents a unit, paid on 9 September 2026. Equity was 10.1 million dollars (31 December 2025: 12.2). Iris has started a strategic review of the casino.

verify.tr: Evrendeki F/K 42,2 ve PD/DD 22,6; oran sayfasında 21,1 ve 11,3: tam iki kat. Neden: fonun tablolarında paylar bileşik finansal araç sayılır (dipnot 6 ve 15). Çıkarılan payların (170,102 milyon dolar) yarısı özsermaye (85,051), yarısı yükümlülüktür (85,051); dağıtılabilir kârın ilk yarısı "pay sahiplerine ait finansman gideri" yazılır, kalan yarısı kâr görünür. Evren, tablodaki kârı ve özsermayeyi 49.801.036 payın tamamına böler: son 12 ay kârı 5,410 + 1,649 − 1,650 = 5,409 milyon dolar, 228,1 ÷ 5,409 = 42,2; özsermaye 10,082 milyon dolar, 228,1 ÷ 10,082 = 22,6. Oran sayfası aynı kârı ve özsermayeyi payların "özsermaye sayılan" yarısına (24.900.518) böler: pay başına 21,73 sent, 4,58 ÷ 0,2173 = 21,1. Ekonomik olarak doğru F/K 21,1'dir (dağıtılabilir kâr 10,818 milyon dolar ÷ 49,8 milyon pay). Ama iki PD/DD de pay sahiplerinin gerçek parasını göstermez: özsermaye + yükümlülük sayılan paylar = 95,133 milyon dolar, 228,1 ÷ 95,133 = 2,4. Buna göre getiri 10,818 ÷ 95,133 = %11,4 (enflasyondan önce); kaynağın %45-68'lik özsermaye kârlılığı bu sınıflamanın sonucudur. Ayrıca fiyat (4,58) Iris'in pay başına 4,67 dolarlık nakit teklifine yapışmıştır.
verify.en: P/E is 42.2 and P/B 22.6 in the universe; 21.1 and 11.3 on the ratio page: exactly double. The cause: in the trust's accounts the units are treated as a compound financial instrument (notes 6 and 15). Half of issued units (170.102 million dollars) is equity (85.051) and half is a liability (85.051); the first half of distributable profit is booked as "finance costs attributable to unitholders" and only the other half appears as profit. The universe divides the reported profit and equity by all 49,801,036 units: last 12 months' profit 5.410 + 1.649 − 1.650 = 5.409 million dollars, 228.1 ÷ 5.409 = 42.2; equity 10.082 million dollars, 228.1 ÷ 10.082 = 22.6. The ratio page divides the same profit and equity by the "equity" half of the units (24,900,518): 21.73 cents a unit, 4.58 ÷ 0.2173 = 21.1. The economically right P/E is 21.1 (distributable profit of 10.818 million dollars ÷ 49.8 million units). But neither P/B shows unitholders' real funds: equity plus the units classed as a liability = 95.133 million dollars, 228.1 ÷ 95.133 = 2.4. On that basis the return is 10.818 ÷ 95.133 = 11.4% (before inflation); the source's 45-68% return on equity is a result of this classification. Also, the price (4.58) is pinned to Iris's cash offer of 4.67 dollars a unit.

BHP.one: Çok büyük bir bakır ve demir cevheri madencisi. Kalite surlarını geçti; kârı emtia fiyatları belirlediği için hendek surunda elendi.
BHP.business: BHP bakır, demir cevheri ve kömür çıkarır ve satar. Haziran 2026'da biten yılda hasılat 58,8 milyar ABD doları, düzeltilmiş FAVÖK 32,9 milyar ABD doları oldu. FAVÖK'ün 18,2 milyar doları bakırdan, 14,5 milyar doları demir cevherinden, 0,8 milyar doları kömürden geldi; bakırın payı %54 (bir yıl önce %45). Üretim: 265 milyon ton demir cevheri, 1.953 bin ton bakır. Şirket ABD doları ile raporlar; hisse Avustralya doları ile işlem görür.
BHP.moat_text: Hendek yok sınıfında. Bakır ve demir cevheri emtiadır; fiyatı dünya piyasası belirler. Bakır FAVÖK'ü bir yılda 12,3 milyar dolardan 18,2 milyar dolara çıktı, oysa bakır üretimi %3 azaldı (2.017 bin tondan 1.953 bin tona); artış fiyattan geldi. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı da döngüyü izliyor: 2022 mali yılında %32,6, 2024'te %16,9, 2026'da %18,9. Şirketin gerçek bir üstünlüğü var: madenleri düşük maliyetli (Batı Avustralya demir cevherinde ton başına 19,66 dolar, Escondida'da libre başına 1,07 dolar; FAVÖK marjı %59). Bu üstünlük fiyat düştüğünde zararı önler, ama fiyatlama gücü vermez. Kurala göre emtia işinin B puanı 0'dır; şirket bu surda elendi.
BHP.mgmt: Kâr temettüye ve yeni madenlere gidiyor. 2026 mali yılı temettüsü hisse başına 172 ABD senti (bir yıl önce 110); son temettü 99 sent, dağıtım oranı %72. Geri alım açıklanmadı. Yatırım ve arama harcaması 10,3 milyar dolar; 2027 için yaklaşık 11 milyar dolar bekleniyor. Net borç 12,9 milyar dolardan 8,7 milyar dolara indi. Kusur: Kanada'daki Jansen potas projesi için 2,3 milyar dolar değer düşüklüğü yazıldı; ikinci aşamanın maliyet tahmini 4,9 milyar dolardan 6,9 milyar dolara çıktı. Brezilya'daki Samarco baraj çöküşü için yıl içinde 1,1 milyar dolar daha gider yazıldı; karşılık 30 Haziran 2026'da 5,2 milyar dolar. Bu yüzden şirketin "düzeltilmiş" kârına (13,2 milyar dolar) değil, açıklanan kâra (9,8 milyar dolar) bakıyoruz. Genel müdür Brandon Craig Temmuz 2026'da göreve başladı. Ana ortaklığa ait özsermayeye, hisse bazlı ücrete ve şerefiyeye bakıldı; okunan belgelerde yok.

en.one: A very large copper and iron ore miner. It passed the quality walls but failed the moat wall because commodity prices set its profit.
en.business: BHP mines and sells copper, iron ore and coal. In the year to June 2026 revenue was 58.8 billion US dollars and underlying EBITDA 32.9 billion US dollars. Of that EBITDA, 18.2 billion dollars came from copper, 14.5 billion from iron ore and 0.8 billion from coal; copper's share was 54% (45% a year earlier). Production: 265 million tonnes of iron ore and 1,953 thousand tonnes of copper. The company reports in US dollars; the shares trade in Australian dollars.
en.moat_text: No moat under our rule. Copper and iron ore are commodities; the world market sets the price. Copper EBITDA rose from 12.3 billion dollars to 18.2 billion in a year, while copper production fell 3% (from 2,017 to 1,953 thousand tonnes); the rise came from price. Real return on equity follows the cycle too: 32.6% in fiscal 2022, 16.9% in 2024, 18.9% in 2026. The company has a real advantage: its mines are low-cost (19.66 dollars a tonne at Western Australia Iron Ore, 1.07 dollars a pound at Escondida; EBITDA margin 59%). That advantage prevents losses when prices fall, but it gives no pricing power. Under the rule a commodity business scores 0 on B; the company fails this wall.
en.mgmt: Profit goes to dividends and new mines. The dividend for fiscal 2026 was 172 US cents a share (110 a year earlier); the final dividend was 99 cents, a payout ratio of 72%. No buyback was announced. Capital and exploration spending was 10.3 billion dollars; about 11 billion is expected for 2027. Net debt fell from 12.9 billion dollars to 8.7 billion. Flaws: an impairment of 2.3 billion dollars was booked on the Jansen potash project in Canada; the cost estimate for its second stage rose from 4.9 billion dollars to 6.9 billion. A further 1.1 billion dollars was charged in the year for the Samarco dam failure in Brazil; the provision stood at 5.2 billion dollars at 30 June 2026. For that reason we look at reported profit (9.8 billion dollars), not the company's "underlying" profit (13.2 billion). Chief executive Brandon Craig took office in July 2026. We looked for equity attributable to shareholders, share-based pay and goodwill; not in the documents we read.
en.latest: 18 August 2026: The company announced results for the year ended 30 June 2026. Revenue was 58.8 billion US dollars (51.3 a year earlier; +15%), attributable profit 9.8 billion dollars (9.0; +9%) and earnings per share 193.6 cents (177.8). Net operating cash flow was 21.8 billion dollars and free cash flow 9.8 billion. Guidance for fiscal 2027: 1,650-1,800 thousand tonnes of copper (1,953 in 2026) and 260-272 million tonnes of iron ore.

WES.business: Wesfarmers perakende zincirleri işleten çok kollu bir gruptur. Haziran 2026'da biten yılda hasılat 47,3 milyar dolar, net kâr 2.874 milyon dolar oldu. Kollarına göre vergi öncesi kâr: Bunnings (yapı market) 2.455 milyon dolar, Kmart Group (ucuz genel mağaza) 1.109 milyon, kimya, enerji ve gübre (WesCEF) 473 milyon, Officeworks (kırtasiye ve ofis) 165 milyon, sağlık (ecza dağıtımı ve eczaneler) 76 milyon, endüstriyel ve iş güvenliği 76 milyon. OneDigital 73 milyon dolar zarar yazdı. Kârın yaklaşık beşte dördü Bunnings ve Kmart'tan gelir.
WES.moat_text: Hendek geniş sınıfta. Kanıt iki perakende zincirinin sermaye getirisi: şirketin açıkladığı yatırılan sermaye getirisi Bunnings'te %69,2 (bir yıl önce %71,5), Kmart Group'ta %68,3 (%67,6). Bunnings'in hasılatı 20,4 milyar dolar, Kmart Group'un 11,8 milyar dolar; bu ölçekte bu getiriyi yakalamak bir rakip için yıllar ve büyük sermaye ister. İkisinin satışı 2026'da da arttı (Bunnings +%3,9, Kmart +%2,8). Kazanç istikrarlı: reel özsermaye kârlılığı beş yılda ortalama %25,6, en düşük yılında %17,4; son yıl %28,0. Zayıf yanlar: öbür kollar aynı kalitede değil. Sermaye getirisi sağlıkta %4,2, endüstriyelde %9,8, Officeworks'te %13,0, WesCEF'te %12,6; WesCEF'in kârı emtia fiyatlarına (lityum, amonyak) bağlı. Özsermaye kârlılığı kısmen sermaye iadesiyle küçülen özsermayeden ve kiralamadan gelir: özsermaye 9.189 milyon dolardan 7.977 milyon dolara indi, kira yükümlülüğü 7.070 milyon dolar. Brüt marjın enflasyon yıllarındaki seyrine bakıldı; okunan belgelerde yok.
WES.mgmt: Kâr ortağa dönüyor. 2026 mali yılı temettüsü hisse başına 222 sent (bir yıl önce 206), tamamı vergi kredili. Aralık 2025'te ayrıca hisse başına 1,50 dolar dağıtıldı (1,10 dolar sermaye iadesi, 0,40 dolar özel temettü; toplam 1.703 milyon dolar). Dağıtım kârı aştığı için net finansal borç 4.231 milyon dolardan 5.295 milyon dolara çıktı; borç/FAVÖK 1,9 (şirketin açıkladığı). Sermaye tahsisinde küçük kusurlar var: Catch kapatıldı (2025'te 51 milyon dolar gider), sağlık kolunun sermaye getirisi %4,2, OneDigital zarar yazıyor. Coregas satıldı (2025'te 233 milyon dolar vergi öncesi kazanç). Şerefiye ve maddi olmayan varlıklar 4.964 milyon dolar, özsermayenin %62'si. Yıl içinde tamamlanan satın alma yok. Büyük ortaklara, hisse bazlı ücrete, emeklilik ve garanti yükümlülüklerine bakıldı; okunan belgelerde yok.

Geçen yılın kârında 273 milyon dolar vergi sonrası tek seferlik kazanç vardı; o hariç kâr %8,3 arttı. Bu yıl tek seferlik kalem yok. İşletme nakit akışı 4.272 milyon dolar (−%6,5). Son temettü 120 sent, 7 Ekim 2026'da ödendi. Yeni yılın ilk yedi haftasında Bunnings satışları ikinci yarıdan biraz güçlü; şirket maliyet baskısının süreceğini, borçlanma giderinin artacağını söyledi.

en.one: A conglomerate that owns Bunnings and Kmart. The moat is wide; both chains earn very high returns on capital. It failed the price test.
en.business: Wesfarmers is a conglomerate that runs retail chains. In the year to June 2026 revenue was 47.3 billion dollars and net profit 2,874 million dollars. Pre-tax earnings by division: Bunnings (home improvement) 2,455 million dollars, Kmart Group (low-price general merchandise) 1,109 million, chemicals, energy and fertilisers (WesCEF) 473 million, Officeworks (office supplies) 165 million, Health (pharmaceutical distribution and pharmacies) 76 million, Industrial and Safety 76 million. OneDigital lost 73 million dollars. About four fifths of earnings come from Bunnings and Kmart.
en.moat_text: The moat is wide. The evidence is the return on capital of the two retail chains: the company-reported return on capital was 69.2% at Bunnings (71.5% a year earlier) and 68.3% at Kmart Group (67.6%). Bunnings has revenue of 20.4 billion dollars and Kmart Group 11.8 billion; matching that return at that scale would take a rival years and a great deal of capital. Sales at both grew again in 2026 (Bunnings +3.9%, Kmart +2.8%). Earnings are steady: real return on equity averaged 25.6% over five years, 17.4% in the weakest year and 28.0% last year. Weak points: the other divisions are not of the same quality. Return on capital was 4.2% in Health, 9.8% in Industrial, 13.0% at Officeworks and 12.6% at WesCEF; WesCEF's earnings depend on commodity prices (lithium, ammonia). Return on equity also comes partly from equity shrunk by capital returns and from leasing: equity fell from 9,189 million dollars to 7,977 million, and lease liabilities are 7,070 million. We looked for gross margin in the inflation years; not in the documents we read.
en.mgmt: Profit goes back to the owner. The dividend for fiscal 2026 was 222 cents a share (206 a year earlier), fully franked. In December 2025 a further 1.50 dollars a share was distributed (a capital return of 1.10 dollars and a special dividend of 0.40; 1,703 million dollars in total). Because distributions exceeded profit, net financial debt rose from 4,231 million dollars to 5,295 million; debt to EBITDA was 1.9 (company-reported). There are small flaws in capital allocation: Catch was wound down (costs of 51 million dollars in 2025), the Health division's return on capital is 4.2%, and OneDigital is loss-making. Coregas was sold (a pre-tax gain of 233 million dollars in 2025). Goodwill and intangibles are 4,964 million dollars, 62% of equity. No acquisition was completed in the year. We looked for major shareholders, share-based pay, and pension and guarantee obligations; not in the documents we read.
en.latest: 27 August 2026: The company announced results for the year ended 30 June 2026. Revenue was 47,274 million dollars (+3.4%), net profit 2,874 million dollars (2,926 a year earlier; −1.8%) and earnings per share 253.4 cents (258.0). Last year's profit included one-off gains of 273 million dollars after tax; excluding them profit rose 8.3%. There were no one-off items this year. Operating cash flow was 4,272 million dollars (−6.5%). The final dividend of 120 cents was paid on 7 October 2026. In the first seven weeks of the new year Bunnings sales were slightly stronger than in the second half; the company said cost pressure will continue and borrowing costs will rise.
risks: Return on equity comes partly from shrinking equity: with the capital return and special dividend, equity fell from 9,189 million dollars to 7,977 million in a year, and net financial debt rose to 5,295 million.
About four fifths of earnings come from two chains and depend on household spending; if housing and consumer spending weaken, Bunnings and Kmart are hit together.
The other divisions earn low returns on capital (Health 4.2%); new capital sent there pulls the group's return down.
Lease liabilities are 7,070 million dollars; the source's net debt to EBITDA of 2.5 is close to the threshold (3.0).
WesCEF's earnings depend on lithium and chemical prices; lithium lost 59 million dollars in 2025 and earned 40 million in 2026.

ALL.one: Kumarhanelere slot makinesi ve oyun içeriği satar, kiralar; mobil kumarhane oyunları işletir. Hendek dar. Fiyat ölçütü geçemedi.
ALL.business: Aristocrat kumarhanelere slot makinesi satar ve kiralar, çevrim içi gerçek paralı oyunlara içerik sağlar ve mobil "sosyal kumarhane" oyunları işletir. Eylül 2026'da biten yılda hasılat 6.092,4 milyon dolar oldu. Mart 2026'da biten yarıyılda kol kârları: Aristocrat Gaming (makineler) 1.063,3 milyon dolar, Product Madness (mobil oyunlar) 373,3 milyon dolar, Aristocrat Interactive (çevrim içi) 95,2 milyon dolar. Şirket Avustralya doları ile raporlar.
ALL.moat_text: Hendek dar sınıfta. Kanıt: Kuzey Amerika'da kiralanan makinelerin kurulu tabanında pay %43; makine kolunun kâr marjı %54,2; sosyal kumarhane slot oyunlarında pay %24 (bir yıl önce %23). Kiralanan makineler günlük ücret getirir, gelir yinelenir. Şirket her yarıyılda tasarım ve geliştirmeye 407 milyon dolar harcar (hasılatın %13'ü). Neden geniş değil: üstünlük her yıl yeni ve tutan oyun çıkarmaya bağlıdır. İçerik taklit edilebiliyor: şirket Light & Wonder ile davayı 184 milyon dolarlık anlaşmayla kapattı. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı beş yılda ortalama %15,3, en düşük yılında %10,5; geniş hendeğin göstereceği düzeyde değil. Çevrim içi kolun kârı düşüyor (2026'da %6,2). Brüt marj Mart 2026'da biten yarıyılda yaklaşık %61 (bizim hesabımız); enflasyon yıllarındaki seyrine bakıldı, okunan belgelerde yok.
ALL.mgmt: Kâr geri alıma, temettüye ve satın almalara gidiyor. Mart 2026'da biten yarıyılda 13.805.214 pay 682,7 milyon dolara geri alındı (pay başına yaklaşık 49,45 dolar; bizim hesabımız) ve 302 milyon dolar temettü ödendi. Geri alım programı 2,5 milyar dolara çıkarıldı. Pay sayısı bir yılda 625,5 milyondan 603,1 milyona indi. Son temettü hisse başına 51 sent, ara temettü 50 sent; vergi kredisiz. Satın almalar sürüyor: Awager (112,4 milyon dolar) ve Gaming Analytics (82,5 milyon dolar). Plarium ve Big Fish oyun varlıkları satıldı. Maddi olmayan varlıklar 4.840,6 milyon dolar, özsermayenin (6.172,7 milyon dolar) %78'i. Borç düşük: net borç 948,6 milyon dolar, FAVÖK'ün 0,3 katı (31 Mart 2026). Tek seferlik kalemler her dönem var (satın alma ve bütünleştirme giderleri, iş kapatma); olağan gider sayıyoruz. Genel müdür değişiyor: Dafne Guisard'ın Nisan 2027'de Trevor Croker'ın yerine geçmesi bekleniyor. Hisse bazlı ücret giderine ve büyük ortaklara bakıldı; okunan belgelerde yok.

en.one: Sells and leases slot machines to casinos and runs mobile casino games. The moat is narrow. It did not pass the price test.
en.business: Aristocrat sells and leases slot machines to casinos, supplies content for online real-money gaming and runs mobile "social casino" games. In the year to September 2026 revenue was 6,092.4 million dollars. Segment profit in the half-year to March 2026: Aristocrat Gaming (machines) 1,063.3 million dollars, Product Madness (mobile games) 373.3 million dollars, Aristocrat Interactive (online) 95.2 million dollars. The company reports in Australian dollars.
en.moat_text: The moat is narrow. The evidence: a 43% share of the installed base of leased machines in North America; a 54.2% profit margin in the machines segment; a 24% share of social casino slot games (23% a year earlier). Leased machines earn a daily fee, so revenue recurs. The company spends 407 million dollars each half-year on design and development (13% of revenue). Why not wide: the advantage depends on producing new hit games every year. Content can be imitated: the company closed its case against Light & Wonder with a settlement of 184 million dollars. Real return on equity averaged 15.3% over five years and was 10.5% in the weakest year; that is not the level a wide moat would show. The online segment's profit is falling (6.2% in 2026). Gross margin was about 61% in the half-year to March 2026 (our calculation); we looked for its path in the inflation years, not in the documents we read.
en.mgmt: Profit goes to buybacks, dividends and acquisitions. In the half-year to March 2026 the company bought back 13,805,214 shares for 682.7 million dollars (about 49.45 dollars a share; our calculation) and paid 302 million dollars in dividends. The buyback programme was raised to 2.5 billion dollars. The share count fell from 625.5 million to 603.1 million in a year. The final dividend is 51 cents a share and the interim 50 cents; unfranked. Acquisitions continue: Awager (112.4 million dollars) and Gaming Analytics (82.5 million dollars). Plarium and the Big Fish game assets were sold. Intangible assets are 4,840.6 million dollars, 78% of equity (6,172.7 million dollars). Debt is low: net debt of 948.6 million dollars, 0.3 times EBITDA (31 March 2026). One-off items appear every period (acquisition and integration costs, business exits); we treat them as ordinary costs. The chief executive is changing: Dafne Guisard is expected to succeed Trevor Croker in April 2027. We looked for the share-based pay expense and major shareholders; not in the documents we read.
en.latest: 12 November 2026: According to a trade publication the company announced results for the year ended 30 September 2026. Revenue was 6,092.4 million dollars (−3.2%; +3.8% at constant currency). Reported net profit fell 16.4% to 1.37 billion dollars; last year's profit included income linked to the Plarium sale. At constant currency net profit rose 9.9%. The online segment's profit fell from 130.7 million dollars to 122.6 million. The final dividend is 51 cents a share. The company expects profit growth at constant currency in 2027. We could not open the company's own results document; the figures are from the news report. According to the half-year report of 13 May 2026, profit for the half-year to March 2026 includes net one-off gains of 80.1 million dollars after tax (Light & Wonder litigation settlement 100.3 million dollars).
risks: The advantage depends on hit game content; a few weak years would lower the share of the leased-machine base.
The last 12 months' profit includes one-off gains: a litigation settlement (100.3 million dollars after tax) and asset sales (50.8 million dollars). Earning power is lower than reported profit.
The exchange rate moves profit in Australian dollars: in 2026 revenue rose 3.8% at constant currency and fell 3.2% as reported. The inflation adjustment uses Australian inflation.
Buybacks are made at prices above our cautious value; with acquisitions, intangible assets have reached 78% of equity.
The business depends on gambling regulation; tighter rules would affect machine and online gaming revenue.

basis.tr: Hesap son 12 ayın kârına dayanır. Bu kârın içindeki tek seferlik kazançlar: Light & Wonder dava anlaşması (Ekim 2025 - Mart 2026 yarıyılı): vergi sonrası 100,3 milyon dolar: son 12 ay kârının %7,3 kadarı; Big Fish oyun varlıklarının ve Plarium'un satışından net kazanç (Ekim 2025 - Mart 2026 yarıyılı): vergi sonrası 50,8 milyon dolar: son 12 ay kârının %3,7 kadarı. Aynı dönemin tek seferlik giderleri: Satın almalara bağlı işlem ve bütünleştirme giderleri (Ekim 2025 - Mart 2026 yarıyılı): vergi sonrası 39,2 milyon dolar: %2,9; White Label işinden çıkış giderleri (Ekim 2025 - Mart 2026 yarıyılı): vergi sonrası 26,1 milyon dolar: %1,9; Grup yapısındaki geçmiş değişikliklerden doğan ertelenmiş vergi varlığındaki değişim (Ekim 2025 - Mart 2026 yarıyılı): 5,7 milyon dolar: %0,4. Net etki %5,8; kazanç bu kadar indirildi. Son 12 ayın kârı 0,94 ile çarpılarak kullanıldı.
basis.en: The calculation rests on the profit of the last 12 months. One-off gains inside that profit: Light & Wonder litigation settlement (half-year October 2025 - March 2026): 100.3 million dollars after tax: 7.3% of last-12-month profit; Net gain on the sale of Big Fish game assets and Plarium (half-year October 2025 - March 2026): 50.8 million dollars after tax: 3.7% of last-12-month profit. One-off charges in the same period: Transaction and integration costs from acquisitions (half-year October 2025 - March 2026): 39.2 million dollars after tax: 2.9%; Costs of exiting the White Label business (half-year October 2025 - March 2026): 26.1 million dollars after tax: 1.9%; Change in the deferred tax asset from historical group structure changes (half-year October 2025 - March 2026): 5.7 million dollars: 0.4%. The net effect is 5.8%; earnings were lowered by that much. Last-12-month profit was used multiplied by 0.94.

basis.tr: Formül yılda %7,6 büyüme veriyordu. Yıllık karşılaştırma kullanılmadı: geçen yılın kârında Plarium satışına bağlı tek seferlik gelir vardı (habere göre açıklanan net kâr %16,4 azaldı; sabit kurla tek seferlikler hariç kâr %9,9 arttı). Güncel büyüme verisi bulunamadı; hız indirilmedi.
basis.en: The formula gave growth of 7.6% a year. The full-year comparison was not used: last year's profit included one-off income linked to the Plarium sale (reported net profit fell 16.4% according to the news report; excluding one-offs and at constant currency profit rose 9.9%). No recent growth figure was found; the rate was not lowered.

BXB.one: CHEP adıyla dünyanın en büyük palet havuzunu işletir; hesaplarını ABD dolarıyla tutar. Kalite surlarını ve 3. suru geçti; fiyat ölçütünü geçemedi.
BXB.business: Brambles, CHEP markasıyla palet, kasa ve konteyner kiralar. Müşteri paleti satın almaz; havuzdan alır, kullanır, geri verir. Şirket paleti toplar, onarır ve yeniden gönderir; parayı her kullanımdan alır. 30 Haziran 2026'da yaklaşık 60 ülkede 352 milyon palet, kasa ve konteyneri vardı. 2026 mali yılında satış geliri 7.042,9 milyon ABD doları oldu: Amerika 3.867,1 milyon, Avrupa-Orta Doğu-Afrika 2.579,9 milyon, Asya-Pasifik 595,9 milyon. Şirket Avustralya'da işlem görür ama hesaplarını ABD dolarıyla tutar.
BXB.moat_text: Hendek geniş. Üstünlük havuzun ölçeğinden geliyor: 352 milyon parçalık bir ağı ve onu toplayıp onaran tesisleri kurmak yıllar ve büyük sermaye ister. Rakamlar bunu gösteriyor: yatırılan sermayenin getirisi (şirketin açıkladığı) %22,6; faaliyet marjı Amerika'da %19,4, Avrupa bölgesinde %28,2, Asya-Pasifik'te %36,0. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı enflasyonun yükseldiği yıllarda düşmedi, %13,5'ten %23,5'e çıktı; beş yılın ortalaması %20,7. Şirket maliyet artışını sözleşmelerdeki endeksleme ve ek ücretlerle geri aldığını söylüyor. Zayıf yanı: 2026'da fiyat artışının satışa katkısı yalnız %1 oldu. Nisan 2026'da ABD'de onarım kapasitesi yetmedi; şirket bazı siparişleri karşılayamadı, yeni müşteri alamadı ve havuza geçmek isteyen bir müşteri sıradan ahşap palete döndü. Hendek hizmetin aksamadan verilmesine bağlı. Brüt marjın yıllara göre seyrine bakıldı, okunan belgelerde yok.
BXB.mgmt: Şirketi profesyonel yönetim yürütüyor; sonuçları Graham Chipchase sundu. Büyük ortak bilgisine bakıldı, okunan belgelerde yok. Kâr üçe gidiyor: yeni palet, temettü ve geri alım. 2026'da hisse başına 46,15 ABD senti temettü açıklandı (kârın %64'ü; son temettü %20 vergi kredili). Yıl içinde 35,7 milyon hisse 528,7 milyon ABD dolarına geri alınıp iptal edildi; ortalama fiyat hisse başına yaklaşık 14,8 ABD doları (kendi hesabımız). Bu fiyat bizim temkinli değerimizin üstünde. 2027 için 400 milyon dolara kadar yeni geri alım sürüyor. Hisse bazlı ücret gideri 32,7 milyon dolar, kârın yaklaşık %3'ü. Süren faaliyetlerde olağan dışı kalem yok; sunumda 21 milyon dolarlık bir yeniden yapılanma gideri geçiyor. Şerefiye tutarına bakıldı, okunan bölümde yok. Tanımlanmış fayda planlarının varlığı 157,3 milyon dolar; açık tutarı okunan bölümde yok. Kira yükümlülükleri 1.048,1 milyon dolar.
BXB.latest: 20 Ağustos 2026: Şirket 30 Haziran 2026'da biten mali yılın sonuçlarını açıkladı. Satış geliri 7.042,9 milyon ABD doları (geçen yıl 6.669,7 milyon; sabit kurla +%2). Faaliyet kârı 1.494,4 milyon dolar (geçen yıl 1.371,8 milyon). Ortaklara ait net kâr 954,0 milyon dolar (geçen yıl 896,0 milyon). Hisse başına kâr 70,3 sent (geçen yıl 64,8). ABD'deki onarım darboğazı kârı yaklaşık 90 milyon dolar azalttı. Net borç 2.926,2 milyon dolar, FAVÖK'ün 1,17 katı. Özsermaye 3.232,2 milyon dolar. 2027 için şirket sabit kurla %2-4 gelir ve %2-6 faaliyet kârı artışı bekliyor; ilk yarıda kârın gerileyeceğini, ikinci yarıda artacağını söylüyor. Mayıs 2026'da şirket 2026 kâr beklentisini %8-11'den %3-5'e indirmişti.

en.one: Runs the world's largest pallet pool (CHEP); reports in US dollars. Passed the quality walls and third wall; did not pass the price test.
en.business: Brambles rents out pallets, crates and containers under the CHEP brand. The customer does not buy the pallet; it takes one from the pool, uses it and gives it back. The company collects, repairs and reissues the pallet and is paid for each use. At 30 June 2026 it had about 352 million pallets, crates and containers in about 60 countries. Sales revenue in the 2026 financial year was 7,042.9 million US dollars: Americas 3,867.1 million, Europe-Middle East-Africa 2,579.9 million, Asia-Pacific 595.9 million. The shares trade in Australia but the accounts are kept in US dollars.
en.moat_text: The moat is wide. The advantage comes from the scale of the pool: building a network of 352 million units and the plants that collect and repair them takes years and a great deal of capital. The numbers show it: return on capital invested (as stated by the company) is 22.6%; the operating margin is 19.4% in the Americas, 28.2% in the European region and 36.0% in Asia-Pacific. Real return on equity did not fall in the years when inflation rose; it went from 13.5% to 23.5%, and the five-year average is 20.7%. The company says it recovers cost increases through indexation and surcharges written into contracts. The weak side: price added only 1% to sales in 2026. In April 2026 repair capacity in the US fell short; the company could not fill some orders, could not take on new customers, and one customer that wanted to convert to pooling went back to ordinary wooden pallets. The moat depends on the service running without interruption. We looked for the gross margin by year; it is not in the documents we read.
en.mgmt: The company is run by professional management; Graham Chipchase presented the results. We looked for major shareholders; they are not in the documents we read. Profit goes three ways: new pallets, dividends and buy-backs. Dividends of 46.15 US cents per share were declared for 2026 (64% of profit; the final dividend is 20% franked). During the year 35.7 million shares were bought back and cancelled for 528.7 million US dollars; the average price was about 14.8 US dollars per share (our calculation). That price is above our cautious value. A further buy-back of up to 400 million dollars is under way for 2027. Share-based pay expense was 32.7 million dollars, about 3% of profit. There were no significant items in continuing operations; the presentation mentions a restructuring cost of 21 million dollars. We looked for the goodwill amount; it is not in the section we read. Defined benefit plan assets are 157.3 million dollars; the deficit is not in the section we read. Lease liabilities are 1,048.1 million dollars.
en.latest: 20 August 2026: The company reported results for the financial year ended 30 June 2026. Sales revenue was 7,042.9 million US dollars (6,669.7 million a year earlier; +2% at constant currency). Operating profit was 1,494.4 million dollars (1,371.8 million a year earlier). Net profit attributable to members was 954.0 million dollars (896.0 million a year earlier). Earnings per share were 70.3 cents (64.8 a year earlier). The repair bottleneck in the US cut profit by about 90 million dollars. Net debt was 2,926.2 million dollars, 1.17 times EBITDA. Equity was 3,232.2 million dollars. For 2027 the company expects revenue growth of 2-4% and operating profit growth of 2-6% at constant currency; it says profit will fall in the first half and rise in the second. In May 2026 the company had cut its 2026 profit growth guidance from 8-11% to 3-5%.
risks: If the US repair bottleneck lasts, the loss of customers could become permanent. The company expects the problem to be solved by the end of the first half of the 2027 financial year and sees a further profit impact of 35-55 million dollars in 2027.

The company keeps its accounts in US dollars and earns its profit outside Australia. The inflation adjustment on the page uses Australian inflation; the dollar exchange rate moves the share price and the ratios.
If the cost of pallet timber, labour and transport rises and contracts pass it on late, the margin narrows. In 2026 the average cost of a new pallet rose about 4%.
Buy-backs are being made at a price above our cautious value; lease liabilities (1,048.1 million dollars) are a burden on top of net debt.
In the European region there were contract losses in the South African pallet business and in automotive.

en.one: Owner of realestate.com.au, Australia's largest property listing site. It passed the quality walls and the third wall; it did not pass the price test.
en.business: REA Group runs the property listing site realestate.com.au. It earns money from the fee that agents and property owners pay per listing; the more prominent the listing, the higher the fee. It carries listings for homes for sale, rentals and commercial property. Revenue from continuing operations in the 2026 financial year was 1,730.4 million dollars (1,543.6 million a year earlier). An average of 12.7 million people visited the site each month. Housing.com in India was sold in September 2026.
en.moat_text: The moat is wide. Buyers go to the site with the most listings and sellers list where the most buyers are; breaking that loop takes years. The proof is pricing power: in 2026 the number of homes listed for sale nationally did not change, yet revenue per listing rose 13%; the price of the top listing package was raised 7%; the rise for the 2027 financial year is 8%. The EBITDA margin excluding associates is 61%. Real return on equity averaged 24.9% over five years and was 16.2% in its lowest year. The weak side: in September 2026 the company gave the competition regulator (ACCC) a court-enforceable undertaking; for three years it may not use contract terms that push agents to place all or most of their listings on its site. The rival Domain is now owned by CoStar and has capped its annual price rise at 4%. The moat holds but is being tested.
en.mgmt: The controlling shareholder is News Corp with 62.01% (2025: 61.42%); four board members are News Corp nominees. Chief executive Cameron McIntyre replaced Owen Wilson in November 2025. Profit goes to dividends and buy-backs: the 2026 dividend is 2.97 dollars per share (fully franked; 2.48 a year earlier). In June 2026 the company bought back 1,257,405 shares for 200 million dollars; the average price was about 159 dollars (our calculation), above our cautious value. The flaw is in investments abroad: a goodwill impairment of 111.0 million dollars was booked on the Indian business in 2026 and the business was sold; the company is now buying 35% of Distilled in Ireland. Goodwill is 610.7 million dollars, about a third of equity. Share-based pay was 15.9 million dollars, about 3% of profit. Restructuring costs were booked two years running (7.8 and 8.0 million dollars). There is no external debt; bank guarantees are 11.3 million dollars.
en.latest: 5 November 2026: The company reported the July-September 2026 quarter. Revenue was 450 million dollars (405 million a year earlier; +11%). EBITDA excluding associates was 294 million dollars (+12%). National listings for sale fell 2%; Sydney and Melbourne together fell 16%. October listings were 13% below last year. The company left its full-year outlook unchanged. Quarterly net profit was not disclosed. In the 2026 financial year, reported on 6 August 2026, net profit attributable to owners was 551.6 million dollars (677.9 million a year earlier), or 418.4 cents per share (513.3 a year earlier). The fall came from the 111.0 million dollar impairment of the Indian business; last year's profit included a 117.0 million dollar impairment reversal linked to the sale of PropertyGuru. The company's profit excluding these items was 650.5 million dollars (564.4 million a year earlier). Equity was 1,908.6 million dollars; cash was 366 million dollars.
risks: Revenue depends on the number of homes listed for sale; with listings falling, growth comes from price rises alone. October 2026 listings were 13% below last year.
The undertaking given to the competition regulator makes it easier for agents to list on other sites as well; Domain, owned by CoStar, is trying to win share with smaller price rises.
Price rises of 7-8% a year may draw a reaction from agents and sellers, or new regulation.
News Corp holds 62.01% of the shares; minority shareholders have limited say. Investments abroad have so far ended in impairments.

en.business: Pro Medicus sells Visage 7, the software radiologists use to open and read medical images. Hospitals sign multi-year contracts and pay for each image read. Revenue in the 2026 financial year was 261.7 million dollars (+22.9%): 236.8 million from North America, 19.0 million from Australia and 5.9 million from Europe. The company has 153 employees. Eleven of the top twenty US hospitals are customers; no customer accounts for more than 10% of revenue.
en.moat_text: The moat is wide. Once a hospital has moved its image archive and workflow onto this software, switching is costly and risky. The evidence: in 2026 all six contracts that came up for renewal were renewed for five years (141 million dollars); ten new contracts worth at least 407 million dollars were signed. The operating profit margin is 74.9%; a margin at this level is possible only for a business that does not have to set its price by its rivals. Real return on equity was 37.7% in the lowest of five years. The trailing reading of 67.8% is inflated by an investment gain. The weak side: the company says it has about 11% of the US market; most of the market is still held by large rivals, and nine tenths of revenue come from one country. We looked for the gross margin by year; it is not in the document.
en.mgmt: The founders run the company: chief executive Dr Sam Hupert holds 24.2 million shares and Anthony Hall 24.2 million; about 23% each (our calculation on the weighted average of 104.5 million shares). There is no debt; cash and financial assets are 252.3 million dollars. The 2026 dividend is 69 cents per share (fully franked; 55 a year earlier). 10.1 million dollars was spent on buy-backs; the share price is far above our cautious value. One item is outside the core business: the company invested 10 million dollars in 4DMedical; the investment was carried at 182.0 million dollars at 30 June 2026 and a fair value gain of 174.2 million dollars was booked in profit. The value had fallen to 149.1 million dollars by 17 August 2026. Share-based pay was 4.2 million dollars, about 2% of profit. Capitalised development cost was 8.2 million dollars and its amortisation 6.9 million dollars. We looked for goodwill and off-balance-sheet obligations; they are not in the section we read.
en.latest: 21 October 2026: The company signed a seven-year, 43 million dollar contract with Virtua Health in the US. In the 2026 financial year, reported on 18 August 2026, revenue was 261.7 million dollars (213.0 million a year earlier). Reported net profit was 265.3 million dollars (115.2 million a year earlier); diluted earnings per share were 253.6 cents (110.1 a year earlier). Of this profit, 121.9 million dollars is the after-tax fair value gain on financial assets and has not turned into cash. Excluding that item and currency differences, the company's profit was 144.7 million dollars (116.6 million a year earlier; +24.1%). Equity was 450.9 million dollars (257.0 million a year earlier). The final dividend is 37 cents per share.
risks: About 46% of trailing profit is the unrealised fair value gain on the 4DMedical investment. The source's P/E and return on equity include this gain; the ordinary profit of the business is 144.7 million dollars.
About 90% of revenue comes from the US; the dollar exchange rate and US hospital budgets feed straight into profit. Currency lowered growth in 2026 (revenue growth at constant currency was 28.4%).
Revenue depends on the number of images read; if a large customer does not renew, or AI tools change pricing, growth slows.
The price assumes very high growth lasting for many years; the calculation caps growth at 25% a year.

en.one: Sells private health insurance under the Medibank and ahm brands. Passed the quality walls and third wall; did not pass the price test.
en.business: Medibank Private sells private health insurance in Australia under the Medibank and ahm brands; it also provides health services under the Amplar Health name. It earns money from the gap between premiums collected and claims paid, and from investment income on the premium fund. Revenue in the 2026 financial year was 9,115.2 million dollars; premium revenue from resident customers was 8,267.9 million dollars. More than six million people hold a Medibank policy. Insurance operating profit was 769.8 million dollars and the health services arm earned 100.7 million dollars.
en.moat_text: The moat is narrow. The advantage comes from scale: the company bargains with hospitals on large volumes and its expense ratio stays at 8.0%; the company says this is among the lowest in the industry. The result is steady: the insurance gross margin is 17.0% and the operating margin 9.0%, both the same as last year. Real return on equity averaged 17.1% over five years and was 10.2% in its lowest year. Why not wide: the government approves the premium increase every year (5.10% on 1 April 2026), so the company cannot set its price alone. Customers can move to another insurer easily: the lapse rate rose to 10.5% and the Medibank brand grew only 0.6%. We looked for a market share figure; it is not in the documents we read.
en.mgmt: The company is run by professional management: chief executive David Koczkar, chair Mike Wilkins. We looked for major shareholders; they are not in the section we read. Most of the profit goes to dividends: 19.2 cents per share in 2026 (fully franked; 18.0 a year earlier), 83.0% of the company's underlying profit. The rest is invested in the health services arm: Better Medical was bought for 163.5 million dollars; goodwill rose to 507.3 million dollars (about a fifth of equity). This purchase is related to the core business. Share-based pay was 11.4 million dollars, about 2% of profit. Costs related to the 2022 cyber attack have been booked for four years (34.9 million dollars in 2026, 39.7 million in 2025); the company treats them as one-off, we treat them as ordinary costs. The company does not state its return on assets.
en.latest: 20 August 2026: The company reported results for the financial year ended 30 June 2026. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 638.7 million dollars (500.8 million a year earlier; +27.5%), or 23.2 cents per share (18.2 a year earlier). Most of the rise comes from the absence of the COVID-19 provision that cut last year's profit by 128.0 million dollars. The company's underlying profit was 636.8 million dollars (618.7 million a year earlier; +2.9%). Resident policyholders grew 1.1%. Investment income fell to 178.9 million dollars (-13.9%). Net assets were 2,410.7 million dollars. The final dividend is 10.9 cents per share. The annual general meeting will be held on 18 November 2026.
risks: Lawsuits over the 2022 cyber attack continue: the information commissioner seeks penalties of up to 2.2 million dollars per contravention and argues for a separate contravention for each person (9.7 million people); there are also consumer and shareholder class actions. The company has made no provision and says it cannot estimate the amount.
The government approves premium increases; if the approval falls short of claims growth, the margin narrows.
Customers are moving to cheaper insurers: the lapse rate rose to 10.5%; according to an analyst note, policyholder growth slowed to 0.2% in the second half of 2026.
After the cyber attack the regulator APRA imposed an extra capital requirement of 250 million dollars; it is still in place and ties up capital.
Investment income depends on interest rates and markets; income on the 3.4 billion dollar portfolio fell 13.9% in 2026.

en.one: Runs lotteries and Keno in Australia under state licences. Passed the quality walls and third wall; did not pass the price test.
en.business: The Lottery Corporation runs lottery and Keno games under licence in the Australian states: Powerball, Oz Lotto, Saturday Lotto, Set for Life. It earns the share of ticket sales left after prizes and state taxes. Revenue in the 2026 financial year was 3,582.5 million dollars: lotteries 3,218.2 million, Keno 364.3 million. Digital channels made up 46.6% of sales.
en.moat_text: The moat is wide. The company operates under a licence in each state and the licences are very long: New South Wales April 2050, Victoria June 2068 (extended by 40 years in May 2026), Queensland July 2072, South Australia December 2052. A rival can enter only if a state grants a licence. Pricing power shows in the numbers: the Powerball price was raised 16.7% in November 2025 and 63% of the rise was retained; average Saturday Lotto sales rose 13.3% after the May 2025 change. Return on invested capital stayed between 18.6% and 24.5% over five years. Return on equity (89% real and above) is not a meaningful measure: equity is only 264.1 million dollars. The weak side: a licence depends on the government's decision and is expensive (the Victorian extension cost 1,145 million dollars); online Keno is banned from 1 January 2027.
en.mgmt: The company is run by professional management: chief executive Wayne Pickup replaced Sue van der Merwe on 9 December 2025; the chairman is Doug McTaggart. We looked for major shareholders; they are not in the section we read. More than all of the profit goes to dividends: 16.5 cents per share in 2026 (fully franked), against earnings of 12.8 cents per share; the payout was 107% of the company's profit before significant items. From 2027 the target is 80-100% of profit with licence amortisation added back. The 1,145 million dollar price of the Victorian licence is being paid with debt (an 800 million dollar note issue). Because no profit is kept in the business and the licence was bought with debt, the D score is 1. Share-based pay was 8.0 million dollars, about 3% of profit. Significant charges of 82.7 million dollars were booked in 2026; there were none in 2025. There is no buy-back. We looked for the goodwill amount; it is not in the section we read; licences are 1,706.4 million and other intangible assets 2,252.7 million dollars.
en.latest: 14 October 2026: At the annual general meeting management said that large jackpots in the first three months of the 2027 financial year were below the model; it gave no figures. It put the full-year EBITDA effect of the online Keno ban at about 25 million dollars. In the 2026 financial year, reported on 19 August 2026, revenue was 3,582.5 million dollars (3,682.7 million a year earlier; -2.7%), net profit 284.6 million dollars (365.5 million a year earlier; -22.1%) and earnings per share 12.8 cents (16.4 a year earlier). Net profit before significant items was 342.5 million dollars (-6.3%). Powerball and Oz Lotto sales fell 10.6%; there was no 100 million dollar Powerball jackpot during the year. Net debt was 2,259.7 million dollars, 3.1 times EBITDA (as stated by the company). Equity was 264.1 million dollars (321.8 million a year earlier).
risks: Debt is rising: net debt at 30 June 2026 (2,259.7 million dollars) does not include the 1,145 million dollar price of the Victorian licence; it is being paid with debt in July and October 2026. The two together come to about 4.6 times 2026 EBITDA (our calculation); the company's target range is 3.0-4.0 times. The source's debt ratio (2.88) dates from before this payment.
The dividend is above profit: 16.5 cents per share was paid for 2026 against earnings of 12.8 cents. Equity fell to 264.1 million dollars.
Sales depend on large jackpots forming; the company says bad jackpot luck cut sales by about 700 million dollars in 2026. Real profit has declined over five years; the calculation assumes shrinkage.
Licences and game rules depend on state and federal government decisions: online Keno is being banned, and the ACT Keno licence (57.0 million dollars) was written off in full.
